Exercise: SEATED LEG CURL mid-curl. Whole compact weight-stack machine, torso upright against slightly reclined backrest, buttocks on seat. Seat edge behind knees; pivot at knee axis. A broad restraint pad lies across FRONT TOP of distal thighs just ABOVE knees. Separate moving roller presses against BACK of lower calves just ABOVE heels; knees flexed roughly75degrees so feet are under and slightly ahead of seat. Hands grasp side handles; spine neutral. Crucial roller contacts back of ankles, not front shins. Both feet point naturally. Side-biased three-quarter view showing distinct thigh restraint and ankle roller with mechanically attached side lever and weight stack. Highlight only small exposed back-of-thigh hamstring regions if visible; never through pad or clothing. No quadriceps or calves highlighted.
